direct_source_results.contact_value: If (I+K)n=0 then Gamma(-K)^m n=Gamma n at every finite depth.
direct_source_results.regular_functional_calculus_scope: Every scalar function of K regular at -1 leaves residual multiplier one; only a pole at -1 removes it.
direct_source_results.scope_nonclaim: This does not classify noncommuting completed-source pieces or convergent infinite nonlocal synthesis.

annihilator_results.exact_coordinate_identity: For M=eta'* and S=-g''*, MS=0 and M Gamma_ext=-M E_a A_dist.
annihilator_results.regular_parametrix_remainder: Gamma_ext=-L M E_a A_dist+(I-LM)Gamma_ext; at an xi zero a regular translation-invariant L leaves residual multiplier one.
annihilator_results.collar_caveat: eta' has full bilateral support, so collar restriction introduces a far-exterior term.
annihilator_results.countermodel: A rational 3-by-3 model has MS=0 and PSP=0 but nonzero old-to-exterior charge.

finite_state_obstruction.theorem: The near-edge completed source has infinite Hankel rank because -g''(epsilon(x+y)) has the scaled Cauchy kernel as its leading term.
licensed_pruning: pure finite-order differential transport of zero-extended old data
finite-rank scalar samples or endpoint jets
not_pruned: boundary-localized or other noncommuting pole--Lerch--prime identities
infinite series with independently proved ambient convergence

four_cauchy_normal_form.kernel: For X=exp(x/2), Y=exp(y/2), x>y, the Lerch part of g'' is (Y/4)sum_(zeta^4=1)(X-zeta Y)^(-1).
four_cauchy_normal_form.other_channels: The exponential completion is rank two, the |t| completion is a local distribution, and prime ramps are dilation atoms X=sqrt(m)Y with Lambda(m)/sqrt(m).
four_cauchy_normal_form.global_result: A local Riemann--Hilbert parametrix has an exact global residual. Independence of exterior readout from the homogeneous solution is E ker(B)=0, which on the genuine state range is exactly Gamma ker(A)=0 (KNC).

compact_source_derivative.causal_ramp_correction: In the whole-line distribution convention V_delta*partial(partial+r)(H b_delta,r)=exp(delta t)S_h-V_delta; the -V_delta collar may be absorbed only by an explicitly declared open-half-line convention or after its support.
compact_source_derivative.transform: L[S_h]=hat(h)+s hat(h)F(1+s); the pole-centered term alone is the transform of S_h-h, modulo an entire tail-truncation correction.
compact_source_derivative.one_sided_endpoint: For one globally fixed sign, epsilon S_h(t)>=-C exp(-theta t), a transform nonvanishing condition, and sufficient smoothing, Landau implies Re(rho)<=1-theta.
compact_source_derivative.converse_scope: With absolute zero-sum decay (for example compact W_c^(3,1) or a sufficiently high-order spline), the strip gives |S_h(t)|=O(exp(-theta t)); generic C_c^1 is insufficient for a lossless converse.

nonclaim: No analytic completed-source factor, fixed-power bound, uniform zero-free strip, RH proof, or four-cycle proof is obtained.
